200.body: Poland has set out a clear language condition that foreigners must satisfy before they can be legally recognised as Polish citizens, according to information published on the country's official government website. The requirement specifies that any individual seeking Polish citizenship must hold a confirmed qualification in the Polish language at B1 level. Poland requires foreigners to hold an official B1-level Polish language certificate for citizenship. In order to be legally recognised as a Polish citizen, you need to have a Polish language qualification at B1 level, you need an official confirmation." 300.summary: "The market currently expects the Polish crop to be around 15 to 20% lower than last season" Despite spring frosts pestering the Polish apple orchards earlier this year, the season is expected to be a positive one, says Jan Nowakowski, manager of Polish apple distributor Genesis Fresh: "The new Polish apple season looks positive overall, although it will certainly be different from last year.
300.body: "The market currently expects the Polish crop to be around 15 to 20% lower than last season" Despite spring frosts pestering the Polish apple orchards earlier this year, the season is expected to be a positive one, says Jan Nowakowski, manager of Polish apple distributor Genesis Fresh: "The new Polish apple season looks positive overall, although it will certainly be different from last year. Based on what we see in the orchards and hear from our growers, the market currently expects the Polish crop to be around 15 to 20% lower than last season. From a market perspective, the reduced Jonagold crop is likely to support stronger prices throughout the season, Nowakowski continues. Polish apples continue to be highly competitive thanks to their quality, wide variety range and the experience of Polish growers.

500.summary: The data shows that Anthropic's Fable 5 model generated 75% as much spend as OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol model did in July, indicating that Anthropic's top model was less popular among businesses.
500.body: OpenAI has an advantage over its rival's priciest and most advanced model, according to new data from Ramp's AI Index. The data shows that Anthropic's Fable 5 model generated 75% as much spend as OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol model did in July, indicating that Anthropic's top model was less popular among businesses. In July, Ramp saw the share of US businesses paying for Anthropic AI products reach 43.5%, compared with 39.7% for OpenAI. Kharazian said that the popularity of Chinese open-source models has grown, though not to the point he'd expect OpenAI and Anthropic to "freak out."' As the number of businesses using OpenAI and Anthropic's products increases gradually, Ramp has seen much faster growth in the amount of money those businesses spend.

Swiatek routed fifteenth-seeded Diana Shnaider 6-2, 6-1 while Svitolina defeated Ekaterina Alexandrova of Russia 3-6, 6-0, 6-3 in the quarterfinal.
